description: Simplify and deduplicate the VCDR codebase. Remove dead code, extract shared concerns, eliminate duplication, and split oversized files — all while keeping the build green and behavior unchanged. Reference thoughts/shared/research/2026-03-14-complexity-and-comprehensibility-audit.md, thoughts/shared/plans/2026-03-14-simplify-coordinators-and-capture-panel.md, and thoughts/shared/research/2026-03-15-architecture-assessment-and-inconsistencies.md for detailed analysis.

userStories.title: Remove dead code across the codebase
userStories.description: Remove unused code that adds noise and maintenance burden. Verify each deletion by searching for all callers before removing.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove CapturePanel.updateCaptures() method — no callers exist
Remove CapturePanel.insertSegment() method — no callers exist
Remove CapturePanel.insertTextAtCursor() if it is just an alias for appendTextToActiveSegment with no distinct callers
Remove PostTranscriptionActionType enum in AppSettings.swift if only used for legacy Mode decoding — inline the migration type or remove if decoding path is dead
Remove TranscriptionRecord.swift if only used as a migration decoder in TranscriptionHistory — inline the migration Codable struct if still needed, otherwise delete entirely

Remove the phantom .executing state from RecordingCoordinator — it is declared but never entered. Remove it from the State enum and simplify the ~5 guard conditions that reference it (menuBarIcon, updateEscCancel, cancelRecording guard, cancelRecording wasProcessing, onHotkeyDown buzz check, stopRecordingAndTranscribe indicator hide)
Remove duplicate onWillStartRecording/onWillStartInput callback if both trigger the same modeSwitcherCoordinator.confirmAndHideSwitcher() call — keep one, remove the other

Remove dead captures-based segment resolution in CaptureCoordinator.configurePanelAndShow (lines ~481-486) — no caller passes non-empty captures when segments is nil. Simplify to let resolvedSegments = segments ?? [InputSegment()]

userStories.title: Show actionable error feedback for script execution failures
userStories.description: When a bash script mode fails, the user gets no actionable feedback. In the panel path, showProcessingError() logs the error and resets to idle — the error message is never displayed. In the pill/minimized path, the error is shown in a tiny 11pt sub-pill for a few seconds then auto-dismissed. Users need to see what went wrong and be able to copy the error text.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an `errorMessage: String?` property to CaptureViewModel that stores the last processing error

When CapturePanel is expanded (panel.isVisible && !panel.isMinimized): show the error message in the header bar area with a red error icon. The error text should be truncated with ellipsis if too long, but clicking on it copies the full error text to the clipboard (via ClipboardHelper.writeString) and shows brief 'Copied' feedback
When CapturePanel is minimized (pill state): show the error in the pill with a red phase indicator (use existing .error phase). The pill error text should also be clickable to copy the full error
Update CapturePanel+Content.showProcessingError() to set viewModel.phase = .error and viewModel.errorMessage = message instead of resetting to .idle and discarding the message
For streaming errors with partial output (accumulated not empty): still show the partial output AND display the error in the header — don't silently drop the error
The error message should persist until the user starts a new recording or dismisses it (not auto-dismissed on a timer)
Clear errorMessage when starting a new recording, new submission, or when the user dismisses the error
The existing quick-action pill error path (RecordingIndicatorPanel) should also support click-to-copy on the error message sub-pill
Build passes: xcodebuild -scheme vcdr -destination 'platform=macOS' build
E2E tests pass: xcodebuild test -scheme vcdr -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing vcdrTests
userStories.notes: Current error flow: BashRunner throws ActionError.executionFailed('Exit code N: <stderr>') → SubmissionPipeline passes through → CaptureCoordinator catches. Panel path: showProcessingError() logs and resets to idle (error discarded). Quick action path: recordingIndicator shows error in small pill for errorIndicatorDuration then auto-dismisses. Reference thoughts/shared/research/2026-03-15-architecture-assessment-and-inconsistencies.md.

userStories.title: Fix concurrency gaps and cross-layer coupling
userStories.description: AudioRecorder's timer callback runs without actor isolation, ToolAvailabilityChecker blocks the calling thread synchronously, CopiedFeedback has a fire-and-forget Task, OutputDestination depends on GlobalHotkeyManager, and CopiedFeedback imports SwiftUI from the Core layer.
acceptanceCriteria: AudioRecorder: Either add @MainActor to the class or ensure levelTimer callback dispatches to the main actor for audioLevels mutation. The timer fires from Timer.scheduledTimer which uses the current run loop — if called from a background context, it could mutate audioLevels off the main thread

ToolAvailabilityChecker: Make checkAll() async, running process.waitUntilExit() calls via Task.detached or withCheckedContinuation to avoid blocking the main thread. Update the single call site in AppSettings.refreshTemplateAvailability()
CopiedFeedback: Store the Task handle and cancel it in a cleanup path, or document why fire-and-forget is acceptable here. Remove the SwiftUI import by accepting a closure instead of Binding<Bool>

OutputDestination.activationKeyCharacter: Remove the direct dependency on GlobalHotkeyManager.keyNameForCode() from the model layer. Either pass the key name as a parameter from the call site, or move the keyCode-to-name table to a shared Core utility
Remove vestigial NSObject inheritance from AudioRecorder if AVAudioRecorderDelegate is not adopted
